citations.title: Boeing CEO Sees More Work On Company Turnaround in 2026 - Bloomberg

sentences.text: Outside assessments generally credit Kelly Ortberg, chief executive since August 2024, with stabilizing operations: 737 production was stabilized at 38 per month and the FAA jointly agreed in October 2025 to an increase to 42 per month, with third-quarter operating cash flow of $1.1 billion and free cash flow of $0.2 billion, after the manufacturer burned through $14.3 billion of cash in 2024 and auctioned assets following a crippling strike.

Execution gaps persist, including a $4.9 billion pre-tax charge on the 777X program tied to updated certification timing, and consolidated debt of about $53.4 billion leaves the balance sheet stretched.

sentences.quote: "To continue our turnaround, we still have important work ahead of us - perhaps even more than what we accomplished last year," Ortberg said in a companywide memo to employees that was viewed by Bloomberg.
sentences.text: Ortberg has told employees that important turnaround work remains ahead in 2026.
